topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I stumbled upon a peculiar and unexpected scenario today. Someone, somewhere, decided that my art was not just something to be admired or hung on a wall; no, they saw fit to etch it into their flesh. A part of me wonders if they truly understood the depth of what they were imprinting, or if it was just a fleeting moment of aesthetic choice. The permanence of it all, the commitment to a piece of me—forever a part of them. I find myself considering the reach of my work, how it travels and transforms in ways I never anticipated.
